provider.title: Model provider
provider.description: Which AI provider to use. Leave empty to use the value saved from the dashboard (falls back to Anthropic). Requires the matching API key env var: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY.

reviewMode.title: Review mode
reviewMode.description: If true, the agent writes the post and stops WITHOUT publishing to LinkedIn. Leave unset to use the dashboard-saved value (falls back to true — safe by default).

model.title: Model ID
model.description: Model ID for the selected provider (e.g. claude-opus-4-8, gpt-5, gemini-2.5-pro). Leave empty to use the dashboard-saved value or the provider default.

maxWebSearches.title: Max web searches
maxWebSearches.description: Upper bound on web search tool calls per run (cost control; applies to the Anthropic provider). Leave unset for the dashboard-saved value or 8.

maxWebFetches.title: Max web fetches
maxWebFetches.description: Upper bound on web fetch tool calls per run (applies to the Anthropic provider). Leave unset for the dashboard-saved value or 6.
